implementation_summary: AC-STRUCT-4 and AC-STRUCT-5 as fast-check integration properties over the real websocket server, ConnectionHandler tool loop, dispatcher (fetch doubled) and shared/context-usage (only the provider stream is mocked); AC-STRUCT-6 as a unit property over the real useChatGeneration with a faithful minimal conversation store (drops updates to conversations not in state) and an ownership-model oracle. Generators follow each AC; each file also checks generator reach. 100 runs each, fixed seed 20261002 (FC_SEED overrides). No production code touched.
decisions: Both integration properties share one file and harness.
AC-STRUCT-5 oracle models the AC-TOOL-5 amendment: over-budget response ends with chat.error and gets no tool_results; asserted via the emitted tool_result id set.
AC-STRUCT-6 uses a plain store rather than useConversations; update-to-unknown-conversation is recorded as dropped and must be empty.
Disabled-compact AC-STRUCT-4 runs map invalid compact calls to search calls (a disabled compact call is a chat.error by design, outside the property).
caveats: Mutation checks were done by temporary edits restored byte-for-byte from backups (diff empty).
VQ-S7-002 PARTIAL waived by Decider (ACCEPT): examiner misread dependencies_allowed; AC-STRUCT-6 spans transport-client
